item: row 256: rebuild each separate store at the current settings
summary: Settings > Maintenance lists the Wikipedia, law, maps and medical papers stores with their own Rebuild button. The copy is made at 16 KiB pages and checked, the old file is kept as pre-rebuild until removed by click, a busy, damaged or still-open store is refused with its reason, and only the POST route starts it. The lane hold waits new opens, bumps a generation, disposes pools and refuses on connections still open. Release line: Settings > Maintenance can now rebuild each separate store (Wikipedia, law, maps, medical papers) at the current storage settings; a busy store is refused with the reason, and the old file is kept until you remove it.
